name: Chaitanya Maili
title: Staff Engineer · Cloud Native | Golang · Kubernetes · GCP · AWS
aboutMe:
I build systems that other engineers don't have to think about — and teams that don't need me in every room for things to go well.

Over 15 years in the industry, I've worked across the full stack of distributed systems: backend services, cloud-native infrastructure on AWS and GCP, and platform engineering on Kubernetes. At Pantheon, I'm currently leading the migration of a legacy filesystem to a cloud-native architecture — owning the technical direction end to end, from exploration and design through execution, while mentoring a team of engineers through the complexity.

That balance is what I care most about: staying technically sharp enough to make the right architecture call at the right moment, while being invested enough in the people around me that they're growing, not just shipping.

Open to Staff/Principal Engineer and Engineering Manager roles in developer tools, cloud platforms, or infrastructure products.

workExperience.title: Staff Engineer
description: Serving as technical lead for Pantheon's filesystem modernization — migrating legacy storage to a cloud-native architecture across the full lifecycle: discovery, architecture design, team coordination, and hands-on implementation. The migration has driven meaningful reliability improvements and reduced operational overhead accumulated in the legacy storage layer.
Mentoring 2–4 engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and complex technical decisions — focused on building independent problem-solvers, not just shipping the current sprint.

Designed and implemented backend microservices and IaC, improving infrastructure efficiency and scalability. Introduced a monorepo tagging strategy that streamlined CI/CD for customer infrastructure rollouts.
Partnering with engineering leadership on roadmap planning, incident response, and cross-team technical alignment.

workExperience.title: Technical Architect
description: Led a 10+ member development team focused on Drupal 8/9 projects.
Leveraged modern development technologies including Drupal VM/Docksal, Acquia BLT, and Solr search.
Implemented visual regression testing in the CI pipeline, which reduced production UI bugs by 40% post-deployment.
Integrated PHPMD (PHP Mess Detector) into the CI process to enforce code quality standards.
Managed the end-to-end migration of a legacy site to the Drupal platform.
Developed and maintained Google Data Studio reports for project metrics and analytics.
